label: TP
reason: User-controlled cookie value is decoded and passed to doSomething which returns it unchanged as bar. The resulting filename is used directly in new File(...) creating a local filesystem path. ESAPI.encodeForHTML protects against XSS in the HTML output but does not sanitize the path argument for path traversal attacks. An attacker can supply '../etc/passwd' via the cookie to access arbitrary files.

evidence.note: Cookie value decoded into param variable.
Param returned from doSomething assigned to bar.
Unsanitized bar used in new File constructor allowing path traversal.
